For the EU, the Aluminum bars show values of 3.2%, 1.8%, and 1.7% for 2021, 2022, and 2023 respectively. The Kupfer bars display 4.4%, 5.1%, and 1.3% for the same years. The Nickel bars show 24.3%, 23.3%, and 14.6% for 2021, 2022, and 2023. The bars are arranged in the order of the metals listed on the horizontal axis. The values for each year are displayed above the corresponding bars.
